title: env.sandbox.compare request
description: Compare two or more golden `env.sandbox.call` records in the terms that matter for reverse engineering, writing nothing. `read_only`. A textual diff answers the wrong question: it has no idea which fields are inputs, so it reports a changed input register and a changed output register as the same kind of finding, when one is the question and the other is the answer.

records.description: The golden records to compare, in the order they are reported. At least two: one compared against nothing has no answer. The order is part of the question — a difference reports one value per record positionally.

maximum_differences.description: Cap on the differences of each kind that are listed. The true totals are always reported.
